description: This file defines a class 'CheckpointProcess' and related data structures for managing checkpoint writing in a distributed training environment using PyTorch. It handles subprocess creation, communication, and checkpoint writing via multiprocessing and threading.

classes.name: CheckpointProcess
classes.description: Manages a subprocess for distributed checkpoint writing, including subprocess creation, communication, and shutdown.

classes.name: RequestType
classes.description: Enumeration of request types for inter-process communication.

classes.name: WorkerRequest
classes.description: Dataclass representing a request sent to the worker process.

classes.name: WorkerResponse
classes.description: Dataclass representing a response from the worker process.

classes.name: CheckpointProcessConfig
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for checkpoint process parameters such as timeouts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CheckpointProcess, starts subprocess creation asynchronously.

methods.name: _create_subprocess
methods.description: Creates and spawns the subprocess for checkpointing, sets up communication pipe.

methods.name: _subprocess
methods.description: Function run in subprocess to initialize checkpoint writer and handle requests.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends a request to the subprocess via pipe.

methods.name: _recv
methods.description: Receives a response from the subprocess via pipe.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Public method to initiate checkpoint writing asynchronously.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Internal method to perform checkpoint writing, waits for state_dict if Future.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the process and cleans up resources, attempts graceful termination.
